# Aimergentia

> Aimergentia is an engineering studio focused on human + AI pair software development. We pair frontier AI models with disciplined systems engineering to build resilient, ultra-fast, and verified software.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI-Pair Sprints**: Concentrated engineering bursts to ship production features, refactor legacy codebases, and resolve hard architecture bottlenecks.
- **AI-Native Architecture**: Designing deterministic guardrails, structured AST/LSP agent interfaces, and continuous verification loops around stochastic model outputs.
- **Codebase Audits & Hardening**: Eliminating technical debt, standardizing strict CSP and type boundaries, and establishing zero-dependency deployment pipelines.

## Architectural Philosophy
- **Standard Library First**: Minimize external runtime dependencies. Prefer rock-solid standard-library tooling over bloated framework churn.
- **Zero Runtime Client JavaScript**: Ultra-low latency, accessible static HTML/CSS with strict Content Security Policy (`script-src 'none'`).
- **Deterministic Verification**: Every generated line of code is verified through rigorous automated test harnesses and mathematical invariants before deployment.
